figurative_meaning_en: to collect one's dues or settle accounts
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি তোমার কড়ি বুঝে নাও, আমি আর দেব না।
সে তার পুরনো পাওনা কড়ি হিসেবে তুলে নিল।
example_sentences_in_english: You collect your dues; I'm not giving anymore.
He settled his old accounts by collecting his cowries.
history: Refers to cowrie shells used as currency in ancient Bengal trade and economy.
note: Idiom rooted in historical use of cowries as money, implying self-settlement of debts.
